文件系统
File Systems

Slide 3–6

Today — File Systems · Network types and structures · Locating a host · Setting up a connection

File System — Manages disk blocks to provide a file abstraction · Surface* organized into tracks · Tracks divided into sectors · (B0 B1 • • • Bk-1 Bk Bk+1 • • • — Current file position = k) · *Durable storage has many architectures, but ultimately they expose “blocks”

Making a File System — File systems start by formatting raw disk blocks · Designate one (or more) blocks as “super” · Record the rest of the blocks as free

Managing a File System — “Super” block is the master block with information · Type information · Size · Root directory · Free blocks · SFS has a flat directory structure, so the root directory is part of the superblock

幻灯片小错: 标题页日期 "19th Lecture, Nov 11, 2025" 是秋季学期的, 与 2026 年春季不符.

本讲: 文件系统; 网络的类型和结构; 定位主机; 建立连接.

文件系统管理磁盘块, 在其上提供「文件」这个抽象 (上一讲的字节序列 + 文件位置). 磁盘表面分成磁道、磁道分成扇区 (第 9 讲); 不论哪种持久存储 (机械盘、SSD), 最终对外都表现为一个个块.

建立文件系统 (格式化): 指定一个或几个块作为超级块, 其余都记为空闲. 超级块是总控块, 记录文件系统的类型、大小、根目录位置和空闲块信息. 本课作业用的 SFS 只有一层目录 (没有子目录), 根目录直接放在超级块里.

Slide 7–8

Finding a File — A directory is a special file · Maps strings to files · Those files could also be directories

for (fileEntry = 0; (unsigned long)fileEntry < FILE_COUNT_LIMIT;
     fileEntry++) {
    if (superBlock->files[fileEntry].first_block != 0 &&
        strcmp(superBlock->files[fileEntry].name, fileName) == 0) {
        return addOpenFileEntry(fileEntry);
    }
}

(Annotations: Index in directory · Max files in directory · Allocated? · Check name)

Opening a File — Find the file · Create the three table entries · Find an available file descriptor · Allocate an open file table entry · Pos, permissions, etc · Load file info into memory · *SFS is always in-memory, so this is implicit

查找文件: 目录是一种特殊的文件, 把名字映射到文件 (被映射的也可以是目录). SFS 的查找就是遍历目录 (超级块中的 files 数组, 最多 FILE_COUNT_LIMIT 项): 某项已分配 (first_block 不为 0) 且名字相同, 就找到了.

打开文件: 先找到文件, 再建立上一讲的三张表中的表项: 找一个空闲的描述符; 分配一个打开文件表项 (记录位置、权限等); 把文件信息 (相当于 v-node) 载入内存. SFS 整个都在内存里, 最后一步是隐含的.

Slide 9–11

Reading a File — The file system will map file pos to disk blocks · Lots of ways to map · Contiguous · Linked / FAT ← SFS · Indexed

Writing a File — Like reading, but the file could grow · SFS preallocates space · Interesting synchronization

Deleting a File — Like free(), but … · Can open files be deleted? · Two steps: · Removing the mapping · Putting the blocks into the free list

读文件: 文件系统要把文件位置映射到磁盘块. 三种常见方式: ① 连续分配, 文件占一段连续的块, 定位最快, 但文件难以增长、容易产生碎片; ② 链接分配 / FAT, 每块记下一块的编号 (FAT 把这些「下一块」指针集中放在一张表里), SFS 用的就是这种, 顺序读方便, 随机访问要沿链走; ③ 索引分配, 用一个索引块列出文件所有块的编号 (Unix 的 inode 就是这种, 大文件再加多级间接块).

写文件: 和读类似, 但文件可能变大, 要分配新块; SFS 预先分配空间. 多个线程同时写会带来有意思的同步问题. 删除文件: 像 free, 分两步: 删除目录中的映射, 把块放回空闲表. 问题: 已打开的文件能删吗? 在 Unix 中可以: 删除只去掉目录项, 只要还有进程打开着它 (引用计数不为 0), 数据块就保留, 最后一个描述符关闭后才真正释放.

Slide 12–14

SFS Specific Notes — “Shark” File System · Uses mmap to bring the entire “disk” file into memory · Treats the disk as an array of 512-byte blocks · Block 0 is the superblock, other references to 0 are NULLs · Flat directory structure

Further Notes — https://tcpp.cs.gsu.edu/curriculum/sites/default/files/Edupar115.pdf · Scope of assignment: · Average of 200 lines of additional code · 13 hours to complete (9 days of assigned work) · The tricky part is identifying critical sections · Critical sections are defined by the shared variable / resource · That can be two (or more) threads calling the same or different functions

Part of sfs_open

sfs_filesystem_t *superBlock = accessSuperBlock();
int fileEntry;
int emptyEntry = -1;

for (fileEntry = 0; (unsigned long)fileEntry <
     FILE_COUNT_LIMIT;
     fileEntry++) {
    if (superBlock->files[fileEntry].first_block != 0 &&
        strcmp(superBlock->files[fileEntry].name, fileName)
        == 0)
        return addOpenFileEntry(fileEntry);
    else if (emptyEntry == -1 &&
             superBlock->files[fileEntry].first_block == 0)
        emptyEntry = fileEntry;
}

SFS (Shark File System) 是本课实验用的教学文件系统: 用 mmap 把整个「磁盘」文件映射进内存 (第 12 讲的内存映射); 磁盘看作 512 字节块的数组; 块 0 是超级块, 所以其他地方的块号 0 就表示空指针; 目录只有一层. 实验来自一篇教学论文 (链接), 平均要补约 200 行代码, 约 13 小时; 难点是找出临界区: 临界区由共享的变量或资源决定, 可能是两个以上线程调用同一个或不同的函数时访问了同一份数据 (第 22–23 讲).

sfs_open 的一段: 遍历目录时, 找到同名文件就打开它; 顺便记下第一个空闲目录项 emptyEntry, 若文件不存在而需要创建, 就用这一项.

网络的类型和结构
Network types and structures

Slide 16–17

Computer Networks — A network is a hierarchical system of boxes and wires organized by geographical proximity · LAN (Local Area Network) spans a building or campus · Ethernet is most prominent example · WAN (Wide Area Network) spans country or world · Typically high-speed point-to-point (mostly optical) links · Also: SAN (Storage area network), MAN (Metropolitan), etc., etc. · An internetwork (internet) is an interconnected set of networks · The Global IP Internet (uppercase “I”) is the most famous example of an internet (lowercase “i”) · Let's see how an internet is built from the ground up

Hardware Organization of a Network Host

网络是按地理远近组织起来的、由盒子和线缆组成的层次系统. 局域网 (LAN) 覆盖一栋楼或一个校园, 最典型的是以太网; 广域网 (WAN) 覆盖一个国家乃至全世界, 通常是高速点对点 (多为光纤) 链路. 把多个网络互联起来就是一个 internet (小写 i, 互联网络); 全球 IP 因特网 (大写 I, the Internet) 是最著名的一个.

对主机来说, 网络只是又一个 I/O 设备: 网络适配器插在 I/O 总线的扩展槽上, 从网络收到的数据经 I/O 总线和内存总线复制到内存 (通常用 DMA), 发送则反过来.

Slide 18–20

Example Lowest Level: Ethernet — (host — 100 Mb/s — hub — 100 Mb/s — host; port) · Ethernet segment consists of a collection of hosts connected by wires (twisted pairs) to a hub · Spans room or floor in a building · Operation · Each Ethernet adapter has a unique 48-bit address (MAC address) · E.g., 00:16:ea:e3:54:e6

Next Level: Bridged Ethernet Segment

Spans building or campus · Bridges cleverly learn which hosts are reachable from which ports and then selectively copy frames from port to port

Conceptual View of LANs — For simplicity, hubs, bridges, and wires are often shown as a collection of hosts attached to a single wire: (host host ... host)

最底层: 一个以太网段由若干主机用双绞线连到一个集线器 (hub) 组成, 覆盖一个房间或一层楼. 每个以太网适配器有全球唯一的 48 位 MAC 地址. 主机以帧为单位发送数据; 集线器只是把每个端口收到的每一位原样复制到所有其他端口, 所以段上每台主机都能看到每一帧, 只收下目的地址是自己的 (课件 "Operation" 下只列了 MAC 地址一项, 这里按教材 11.2 补充).

上一层: 多个以太网段用网桥连成桥接以太网, 覆盖整栋楼或校园. 网桥会自动学习哪些主机在哪个端口那边, 只把帧转发到需要的端口, 不像集线器那样广播. 为了简单, 画图时通常把集线器、网桥、线缆合起来画成一根线, 所有主机挂在上面.

Slide 21–22

Next Level: internets — Multiple incompatible LANs can be physically connected by specialized computers called routers · The connected networks are called an internet (lower case)

LAN 1 and LAN 2 might be completely different, totally incompatible (e.g., Ethernet, Fibre Channel, 802.11*, T1-links, DSL, …)

Logical Structure of an internet — Ad hoc interconnection of networks · No particular topology · Vastly different router & link capacities · Send packets from source to destination by hopping through networks · Router forms bridge from one network to another · Different packets may take different routes

再上一层: 多个互不兼容的局域网 (以太网、光纤通道、Wi-Fi 802.11、T1 专线、DSL……) 用专门的计算机路由器连起来, 组成 internet. 它的逻辑结构是临时拼凑的, 没有固定拓扑, 各路由器和链路的容量相差悬殊. 数据包从源主机出发, 一跳一跳穿过各个网络到达目的地; 路由器在网络之间起桥梁作用; 不同的包可能走不同的路线.

Slide 23–24

The Notion of an internet Protocol — How is it possible to send bits across incompatible LANs and WANs? · Solution: protocol software running on each host and router · Protocol is a set of rules that governs how hosts and routers should cooperate when they transfer data from network to network. · Smooths out the differences between the different networks

What Does an internet Protocol Do? — Provides a naming scheme · An internet protocol defines a uniform format for host addresses · Each host (and router) is assigned at least one of these internet addresses that uniquely identifies it · Provides a delivery mechanism · An internet protocol defines a standard transfer unit (packet) · Packet consists of header and payload · Header: contains info such as packet size, source and destination addresses · Payload: contains data bits sent from source host

怎样跨越互不兼容的网络传送数据? 靠每台主机和路由器上运行的协议软件. 协议是一组规则, 规定主机和路由器在网络之间传送数据时如何合作, 抹平各网络的差异. 互联网络协议做两件事: ① 命名: 规定统一的主机地址格式, 每台主机 (和路由器) 至少分到一个唯一的地址; ② 传送: 规定统一的传送单位, 叫包, 由包头 (包的大小、源地址、目的地址等) 和有效载荷 (要传送的数据) 组成.

Slide 25–26

Transferring internet Data Via Encapsulation

PH: internet packet header · FH: LAN frame header

Other Issues — We are glossing over a number of important questions: · What if different networks have different maximum frame sizes? (segmentation) · How do routers know where to forward frames? · How are routers informed when the network topology changes? · What if packets get lost? · These (and other) questions are addressed by the area of systems known as computer networking

封装: 主机 A 上的客户发送数据, 协议软件在数据前加上互联网包头 PH (目的地址是主机 B), 再套上 LAN1 的帧头 FH1 (目的地址是路由器), 交给 LAN1 适配器. 路由器收到帧后读出包头, 剥掉 FH1, 换上 LAN2 的帧头 FH2 (目的地址是主机 B), 发到 LAN2. 主机 B 收到后逐层剥去帧头和包头, 把数据交给服务器. 包头在整个旅途中不变, 帧头每过一个网络换一次: 这就是一个协议怎样在互不兼容的网络上运行.

还有很多问题这里略过: 不同网络的最大帧长不同怎么办 (分片)? 路由器怎么知道往哪转发? 拓扑变化时怎么通知? 包丢了怎么办? 这些属于计算机网络课程.

Slide 27–28

Global IP Internet (upper case) — Most famous example of an internet · Based on the TCP/IP protocol family · IP (Internet Protocol) · Provides basic naming scheme and unreliable delivery capability of packets (datagrams) from host-to-host · UDP (User Datagram Protocol) · Uses IP to provide unreliable datagram delivery from process-to-process · TCP (Transmission Control Protocol) · Uses IP to provide reliable byte streams from process-to-process over connections · Accessed via a mix of Unix file I/O and functions from the sockets interface

Hardware and Software Organization of an Internet Application

全球 IP 因特网基于 TCP/IP 协议族: IP 提供基本的命名方式, 以及从主机到主机的不可靠的数据报 (包) 传送, 包可能丢失、重复、乱序; UDP 在 IP 之上提供进程到进程的不可靠数据报传送; TCP 在 IP 之上提供进程到进程的、基于连接的可靠字节流. 程序员通过 Unix 文件 I/O 和套接字接口的函数来使用它们.

分层: 客户和服务器是用户代码, 通过套接字接口 (系统调用) 调用内核里的 TCP/IP 实现, 内核再通过硬件接口 (中断) 驱动网络适配器.

Slide 29–30

A Programmer's View of the Internet — 1. Hosts are mapped to a set of 32-bit IP addresses · 128.2.203.179 · 127.0.0.1 (always localhost) · 2. As a convenience for humans, the Domain Name System maps a set of identifiers called Internet domain names to IP addresses: · www.cs.cmu.edu “resolves to” 128.2.217.3 · 3. A process on one Internet host can communicate with a process on another Internet host over a connection

Aside: IPv4 and IPv6 — IPv4 (Internet Protocol version 4) specified 1981 · 32-bit host addresses (192.0.2.43) · Known to not be enough for everyone since ~1990 · IPv6 (Internet Protocol version 6) specified 1996 · 128-bit addresses (2001:0db8:0:0:0:0:cafe:la7e) · Intended to replace IPv4 · Very slow adoption due to need to replace routers (CMU's network doesn't support IPv6 at all!) · Application programmers mostly don't have to care · Sockets API makes it easy to write code that seamlessly uses either, as necessary · (Graph: IPv6 traffic to Google, https://www.google.com/intl/en/ipv6/statistics.html)

程序员眼中的因特网就三点: ① 主机对应 32 位 IP 地址 (127.0.0.1 永远指本机 localhost); ② 为了方便人记, 域名系统 DNS 把域名映射到 IP 地址; ③ 一台主机上的进程可以通过连接与另一台主机上的进程通信. 下面三节分别讲这三点.

IPv4 (1981) 用 32 位地址, 大约 1990 年起就知道不够用; IPv6 (1996) 用 128 位地址, 本意是取代 IPv4, 但因为要更换路由器, 推广很慢 (CMU 的网络完全不支持 IPv6). 图中 Google 统计的 IPv6 流量占比在逐年上升. 应用程序员基本不用操心: 套接字 API 可以写出两者通用的代码 (下一讲的 getaddrinfo).

幻灯片笔误: IPv6 示例地址 2001:0db8:0:0:0:0:cafe:la7e 的最后一组 "la7e" 含字母 l, 不是十六进制数字, 应为 1a7e (数字 1). 另外这个地址按规范可简写为 2001:db8::cafe:1a7e.

Slide 31–32

(1) IP Addresses — 32-bit IP addresses are stored in an IP address struct · IP addresses are always stored in memory in network byte order (big-endian byte order) · True in general for any integer transferred in a packet header from one machine to another. · E.g., the port number used to identify an Internet connection.

/* Internet address structure */
struct in_addr {
    uint32_t  s_addr; /* network byte order (big-endian) */
};

Dotted Decimal Notation — By convention, each byte in a 32-bit IP address is represented by its decimal value and separated by a period · IP address: 0x8002C2F2 = 128.2.194.242 · Use getaddrinfo and getnameinfo functions (described later) to convert between IP addresses and dotted decimal format.

IP 地址存放在 struct in_addr 中. 它在内存里总是以网络字节序 (大端) 存放, 不管主机本身是什么字节序 (x86 是小端, 第 2 讲). 凡是在包头里从一台机器传到另一台的整数都如此, 例如端口号. (主机序与网络序之间用 htonl、htons、ntohl、ntohs 转换.)

点分十进制: 把 32 位地址的每个字节写成十进制, 用点隔开. 0x8002C2F2 的四个字节是 0x80 = 128、0x02 = 2、0xC2 = 194、0xF2 = 242, 即 128.2.194.242. 两种表示之间的转换用后面讲的 getaddrinfo、getnameinfo.

定位主机: 域名
Locating a host

Slide 34–35

(2) Internet Domain Names

Domain Naming System (DNS) — The Internet maintains a mapping between IP addresses and domain names in a worldwide distributed database called DNS · Conceptually, programmers can view the DNS database as a collection of millions of host entries. · Each host entry defines the mapping between a set of domain names and IP addresses. · In a mathematical sense, a host entry is an equivalence class of domain names and IP addresses.

域名构成一棵树: 根没有名字, 下面是一级域名 (.net、.edu、.gov、.com 等), 再往下是二级 (cmu、mit……)、三级 (cs、ece……). 一个完整域名从叶子读到根, 例如 whaleshark.ics.cs.cmu.edu.

因特网用一个全球分布式数据库 DNS 维护域名与 IP 地址之间的映射. 概念上可以把它看成几百万条主机条目, 每条定义一组域名和一组 IP 地址之间的映射; 数学上说, 一个主机条目是域名和 IP 地址的一个等价类.

Slide 36–38

Properties of DNS Mappings — Can explore properties of DNS mappings using nslookup · (Output edited for brevity) · Each host has a locally defined domain name localhost which always maps to the loopback address 127.0.0.1 · Use hostname to determine real domain name of local host:

linux> nslookup localhost
Address: 127.0.0.1

linux> hostname
whaleshark.ics.cs.cmu.edu

Simple case: one-to-one mapping between domain name and IP address · Multiple domain names mapped to the same IP address · And backwards:

linux> nslookup whaleshark.ics.cs.cmu.edu
Address: 128.2.210.175

linux> nslookup cs.mit.edu
Address: 18.25.0.23
linux> nslookup eecs.mit.edu
Address: 18.25.0.23

linux> nslookup 18.25.0.23
23.0.25.18.in-addr.arpa  name = eecs.mit.edu.

Multiple domain names mapped to multiple IP addresses · Some valid domain names don't map to any IP address:

linux> nslookup www.twitter.com
Address: 104.244.42.65
Address: 104.244.42.129
Address: 104.244.42.193
Address: 104.244.42.1

linux> nslookup www.twitter.com
Address: 104.244.42.129
Address: 104.244.42.65
Address: 104.244.42.193
Address: 104.244.42.1

linux> nslookup ics.cs.cmu.edu
(No Address given)

用 nslookup 观察 DNS 映射的几种情况: 每台主机都有本地定义的域名 localhost, 指向回环地址 127.0.0.1 (发往它的数据不出本机); hostname 命令给出本机真正的域名. 映射可以是一对一; 也可以多个域名对应同一个 IP (cs.mit.edu 和 eecs.mit.edu); 反向查询 IP 得到的域名放在特殊的 in-addr.arpa 域下, 地址的四个字节倒过来写. 也可以一个域名对应多个 IP (twitter), 而且每次查询返回的顺序不同, 这样客户会连到不同的服务器, 起到负载均衡的作用. 还有一些合法域名不对应任何 IP (ics.cs.cmu.edu 只是一个中间层的域).

建立连接
Setting up a connection

Slide 40–41

A Client-Server Transaction — Most network applications are based on the client-server model: · A server process and one or more client processes · Server manages some resource · Server provides service by manipulating resource for clients · Server activated by request from client (vending machine analogy) · (1. Client sends request · 2. Server handles request · 3. Server sends response · 4. Client handles response) · Note: clients and servers are processes running on hosts (can be the same or different hosts)

(3) Internet Connections — Clients and servers most often communicate by sending streams of bytes over TCP connections. Each connection is: · Point-to-point: connects a pair of processes. · Full-duplex: data can flow in both directions at the same time, · Reliable: stream of bytes sent by the source is eventually received by the destination in the same order it was sent. · A socket is an endpoint of a connection · Socket address is an IPaddress:port pair · A port is a 16-bit integer that identifies a process: · Ephemeral port: Assigned automatically by client kernel when client makes a connection request. · Well-known port: Associated with some service provided by a server (e.g., port 80 is associated with Web servers)

多数网络应用基于客户端-服务器模型: 一个服务器进程管理某种资源, 为一个或多个客户进程提供服务; 服务器由客户的请求激活, 像自动售货机. 一次事务四步: 客户发请求、服务器处理、服务器发响应、客户处理响应. 注意客户和服务器是进程, 不是机器, 可以在同一台主机上.

客户和服务器通常通过 TCP 连接发送字节流. 连接是点对点的 (连接一对进程)、全双工的 (两个方向可以同时传数据)、可靠的 (发送的字节流最终按原顺序到达). 套接字是连接的端点, 套接字地址是「IP 地址:端口」. 端口是标识进程的 16 位整数: 客户发起连接时由内核自动分配临时端口; 服务器提供的服务对应知名端口 (如 Web 服务器用 80).

Slide 42–43

Well-known Service Names and Ports — Popular services have permanently assigned well-known ports and corresponding well-known service names: · echo servers: echo 7 · ftp servers: ftp 21 · ssh servers: ssh 22 · email servers: smtp 25 · Unencrypted Web servers: http 80 · SSL/TLS encrypted Web: https 443 · Mappings between well-known ports and service names is contained in the file /etc/services on each Linux machine.

Anatomy of a Connection — A connection is uniquely identified by the socket addresses of its endpoints (socket pair) · (cliaddr:cliport, servaddr:servport)

常用服务有固定的知名端口和服务名: echo 7、ftp 21、ssh 22、smtp 25、http 80、https 443, 对照表在每台 Linux 机器的 /etc/services 文件中.

一个连接由两端的套接字地址组成的套接字对 (客户地址:客户端口, 服务器地址:服务器端口) 唯一确定. 所以同一台 Web 服务器的 80 端口可以同时有成千上万个连接, 它们的客户地址或临时端口各不相同.

Slide 44

Using Ports to Identify Services

同一台服务器主机上可以运行多个服务. 请求到达时, 内核根据目的端口决定交给哪个进程: 端口 80 交给 Web 服务器, 端口 7 交给 echo 服务器. IP 地址找到主机, 端口找到主机上的进程.

Slide 46–48

Sockets Interface — Set of system-level functions used in conjunction with Unix I/O to build network applications. · Created in the early 80's as part of the original Berkeley distribution of Unix that contained an early version of the Internet protocols. · Available on all modern systems · Unix variants, Windows, OS X, IOS, Android, ARM

Sockets — What is a socket? · To the kernel, a socket is an endpoint of communication · To an application, a socket is a file descriptor that lets the application read/write from/to the network · Using the FD abstraction lets you reuse code & interfaces · Clients and servers communicate with each other by reading from and writing to socket descriptors · (Client clientfd ⟷ Server serverfd) · The main distinction between regular file I/O and socket I/O is how the application “opens” the socket descriptors

Socket Programming Example — Echo server and client · Server · Accepts connection request · Repeats back lines as they are typed · Client · Requests connection to server · Repeatedly: · Read line from terminal · Send to server · Read reply from server · Print line to terminal

套接字接口是一组系统级函数, 与 Unix I/O 配合构建网络应用. 它诞生于 80 年代初的 Berkeley Unix (BSD), 现在所有系统都支持.

对内核来说, 套接字是通信的一个端点; 对应用程序来说, 套接字就是一个文件描述符, 可以用 read/write 读写网络. 这样能复用文件 I/O 的代码和接口 (例如上一讲的 RIO). 套接字 I/O 与普通文件 I/O 的主要区别只在于怎样「打开」描述符 (下一讲的 socket、connect、bind、listen、accept).

示例程序: echo 服务器和客户. 服务器接受连接, 把收到的每一行原样发回; 客户连接服务器后循环: 从终端读一行, 发给服务器, 读回复, 打印到终端.

Slide 49

Echo Server/Client Session Example

Client

bambooshark: ./echoclient whaleshark.ics.cs.cmu.edu 6616    (A)
This line is being echoed                                   (B)
This line is being echoed
This one is, too                                            (C)
This one is, too
bambooshark: ./echoclient whaleshark.ics.cs.cmu.edu 6616    (D)
This one is a new connection                                (E)
This one is a new connection

Server

whaleshark: ./echoserveri 6616
Connected to (BAMBOOSHARK.ICS.CS.CMU.EDU, 33707)    (A)
server received 26 bytes                            (B)
server received 17 bytes                            (C)
Connected to (BAMBOOSHARK.ICS.CS.CMU.EDU, 33708)    (D)
server received 29 bytes                            (E)

会话示例: 服务器在 whaleshark 上监听端口 6616. 客户在 bambooshark 上连接 (A), 服务器打印客户的域名和临时端口 33707. 客户输入的每一行都被原样回显 (B、C); 服务器报告收到的字节数: "This line is being echoed" 是 25 个字符加换行共 26 字节, "This one is, too" 16 + 1 = 17 字节. 客户输入文件结束 (Ctrl-D) 断开后再次连接 (D), 得到新的临时端口 33708. echoserveri 的 i 表示「迭代」服务器: 一次只服务一个客户.

Slide 50–51

Echo Server + Client Structure

(Slide 51: same structure with the actual functions — Client: fgets, rio_writen, rio_readlineb, fputs, close · Server: accept, rio_readlineb, rio_writen, rio_readlineb (EOF), close)

结构: ① 服务器先启动, open_listenfd 建立监听描述符, 在 accept 处阻塞等待; ② 客户启动, open_clientfd 发出连接请求, accept 返回一个与该客户相连的新描述符; ③ 交换数据: 客户 fgets 读终端、rio_writen 写套接字; 服务器 rio_readlineb 读套接字、rio_writen 写回; 客户 rio_readlineb 读回复、fputs 写终端; ④ 客户读终端遇到 EOF, close 套接字; ⑤ 服务器的 rio_readlineb 随之读到 EOF (返回 0), 关闭这个连接, 回到 accept 等下一个客户. 具体代码在下一讲.

附录是几张历史图: 因特网的前身 ARPANET 1969 年 12 月只有 4 个节点 (斯坦福研究所 SRI、加州大学圣巴巴拉分校、洛杉矶分校、犹他大学); 一年后已经横跨美国, 卡内基 (CMU) 也接入了; 1970 年和 1977 年的逻辑图中, 每个节点是一台 IMP (接口报文处理机, 相当于最早的路由器), 下面挂着 PDP-10 等主机, CMU 的位置被红框标出.

Slide 57–58

(Slide 57: Submarine Cable Map 2022, TeleGeography)

A Map of 460 Billion Device Connections to the Internet collected by the Carna Botnet — (world map: relative IPv4 utilization observed using ICMP Ping requests; Source: Carna Botnet)

2022 年的海底光缆图: 洲际的广域网链路大多是海底光缆. Carna 僵尸网络图: 2012 年有人利用大量设置了默认密码的设备组成僵尸网络, 对整个 IPv4 地址空间做了一次普查 (Internet Census 2012), 图中颜色表示各地对 ping 有响应的 IPv4 地址的活跃程度.

标题数字可疑: "460 Billion Device Connections" 不可能是设备或地址数: IPv4 一共只有 232≈43 亿个地址. Internet Census 2012 报告约有 4.2 亿个地址回应 ping; 「几百亿」只可能是探测记录的条数. 课件没有给出数字的出处, 这里无法核实原意.

Slide 59–60

Basic Internet Components — Internet backbone: · collection of routers (nationwide or worldwide) connected by high-speed point-to-point networks · Internet Exchange Points (IXP): · router that connects multiple backbones (often referred to as peers) · Also called Network Access Points (NAP) · Regional networks: · smaller backbones that cover smaller geographical areas (e.g., cities or states) · Point of presence (POP): · machine that is connected to the Internet · Internet Service Providers (ISPs): · provide dial-up or direct access to POPs

Internet Connection Hierarchy — (IXPs connect Backbones; Private “peering” agreements between two backbone companies often bypass IXP; Colocation sites; Backbones connect to POPs; POPs serve Regional nets, ISPs, Big Business; ISPs serve individuals via Cable modem, DSL, T1; Small Business; Pgh employee, DC employee)

因特网的组成: 骨干网是用高速点对点链路连接的全国或全球的路由器; 因特网交换点 (IXP, 也叫 NAP) 连接多个骨干网, 它们互称对等方; 区域网是覆盖城市或州的较小骨干网; 接入点 (POP) 是接入因特网的机房; 因特网服务提供商 (ISP) 让用户通过拨号或专线接入 POP. 层次图: 骨干网经 IXP 互联, 两家骨干公司之间也常签私有对等协议绕过 IXP; 骨干网下接 POP, POP 再连区域网、ISP、大企业; 个人通过有线电视调制解调器、DSL 等接入 ISP.
